body:
Rooted in local community, his work records the people and places of working-class Scotland. From the historic streets of Govan to candid moments of everyday life, Mark finds stories in familiar surroundings and unguarded expressions.

Blending street storytelling with intimate portraiture, he creates an archive of Scottish identity: its character, grit and soul. The raw texture of analogue film gives these contemporary photographs a timeless quality, connecting everyday life with a sense of the past.
intro: Mark Spence is a Glasgow-based portrait and street photographer specialising in black-and-white analogue film.
